## Improvement: give optimistic submission one owner

`agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/form.tsx:9`

`optimisticSubmit` and `nextSubmitState` can both move the same form to success. The split ownership makes the transition policy harder to trace and test. This is a cleanliness improvement, not a ship blocker, because the repository has no caller that proves wrong behavior.
